changelog: Investigate can collapse its session list into a 44 px rail with an always-visible restore control, giving the selected call more room.
Audio/RTP Expert, SIP Expert, SIP message details and equivalent advanced sections share one accessible expand/collapse style.
Settings Advanced now expands and collapses from the same control, while Flash Call, trunk alerts, health thresholds, per-trunk overrides and the glossary reuse
